name: Switch
title: Switch
summary: A 46 × 28px toggle switch for settings that take effect at once, shown in a 44px row with a title and a one-line description.
whenToUse: App and account settings that apply immediately: Verse of the day, Download on Wi-Fi only, Play audio automatically.
whenNotToUse: Not inside a form that has a Save or Submit button: use Checkbox there.
Not for choosing between two named options (one-time / monthly): use SegmentedControl.

props.name: label
props.description: Title of the setting: says what is on ("Verse of the day"), not the action.

props.name: description
props.description: One plain line on what happens. When the switch is disabled, say why ("Turn on notifications first").

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state. A switch acts at once: revert it and show an alert if saving fails.

props.name: rowClassName
props.description: Class on the row (`.fm-swrow`). `className` goes on the switch button.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next value. A switch acts at once: never pair it with a Save button.

props.name: label
props.description: Title of the setting: what is on ("Verse of the day"), not the action. Rendered with the row layout.

props.name: description
props.description: One plain line on what happens. Say why when disabled ("Turn on notifications first").

props.name: bare
props.description: Show only the 46x28dp track, without a row. Give it an `accessibilityLabel`.

props.name: style
props.description: Draw the row without its own bottom divider (use inside `SwitchGroup`, which adds dividers).

variantNotes: Focus: 2px `--horizon-blue` outline, 2px offset, `--shadow-focus` (`.fm-focus` for static specs).
Disabled: `disabled` on the button (45% opacity); add `.fm-disabled` to the row so the title turns `--gray-600`, and say why in the description ("Turn on notifications first").

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: A switch acts at once. Never pair it with a Save button; if the change can fail, revert the switch and show an `.alert-err` or toast.
Put the switch on the right, after its label, in every row.
Label says what is on, not the action: "Verse of the day", not "Turn on verse of the day".
On is always Horizon Blue; never green, never red for off.
Make the whole row the 44px tap target.
Use `.fm-settings` to group related settings; keep groups to about 3–6 rows.

Do not rely on the knob position alone: the track colour changes too.
Announce failures (e.g. could not save) in a polite live region.
